anomalies.description: A dense crowd of people wearing yellow vests is engaged in collective unrest; green smoke (likely from a smoke grenade or flare) is deployed in the center, and individuals are moving aggressively around a French flag, with some apparent pushing and jostling. The scene shows chaotic movement and confrontation, consistent with a riot rather than a peaceful demonstration.; The crowd has transitioned to a coordinated sit-in/blockade on a street, surrounding two individuals lying on the ground under French flags. While the immediate violence subsides, the large-scale organized obstruction and presence of multiple flags, smoke residue, and tense postures indicate ongoing riotous activity (civil disobedience as part of a broader riot context).

A large group of riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields, body armor) advances aggressively toward a crowd of protesters wearing yellow vests, pushing through and making physical contact; the crowd reacts with resistance and movement backward, indicating violent group clash.; Protesters, many in yellow vests and some wearing festive hats (e.g., Santa hat), collectively raise arms in coordinated gesture (possibly 'V' for victory or surrender), while facing off against police; tension remains high with close proximity and confrontational postures, consistent with ongoing unrest despite absence of active striking in these frames.

Direct physical engagement between riot police and protesters is visible: officers use batons and shields to push while individuals in yellow vests raise arms defensively or attempt to block; at least one officer appears to strike or shove a protester near the tree trunk.

A dense crowd of protesters wearing yellow vests and some with Santa hats raises arms in unison, facing a line of riot police; physical proximity and tense posturing suggest an active confrontation.; A large crowd of protesters, many wearing yellow vests, is engaged in violent unrest with law enforcement; individuals in riot gear are present, and a significant cloud of smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) erupts and spreads across the scene from ~45.5s onward, indicating active confrontation and dispersal tactics.

Close-up frames show individuals in riot helmets and protective gear in direct physical contact and grappling; one person raises an arm aggressively while others appear to be pushing or restraining each other, consistent with mutual physical combat.

Sudden large plume of white smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenade) erupts in front of the crowd, causing visible dispersal and reaction; multiple individuals raise hands or turn away as smoke spreads across the scene.

A dense crowd of people wearing yellow vests is gathered in a street, with smoke rising near a fire truck and visible tension; individuals appear to be moving aggressively toward or away from the vehicle amid chaotic conditions.

A group of individuals, some in dark clothing and others in yellow vests, are seen running across a street while police officers in riot gear advance; objects (possibly projectiles) are visible mid-air, indicating active confrontation and collective unrest.
Two individuals in yellow vests engage in physical contact: one appears to strike or push the other, who recoils backward; this occurs amid a banner-holding crowd but is localized mutual combat.
